svg.title: Alentejo study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Alentejo; 2: Portalegre; 3: Borba; 4: Estremoz; 5: Redondo; 6: Vidigueira; 7: Alqueva; 8: Moura; 9: Bajolo; 10: Abodaneira; 11: Setúbal; 12: Leiria

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
